::: {.callout-important} 本页依据 9709 Mathematics 2026–2027 syllabus 2.5：把 reverse differentiation 扩展到 $e^{ax+b}$、$1/(ax+b)$、$\sin(ax+b)$、$\cos(ax+b)$ 和 $\sec^2(ax+b)$；使用 trigonometric relationships 进行 integration；理解并使用 trapezium rule 估计 definite integral，并判断 over-estimate 或 under-estimate。 工作区没有独立的 Paper 2 note PDF，因此 worked examples 使用同一套 Integration note PDF 中已经独立提取的相关原始图片；每个例题单独成卡。真题全部来自本地 Paper 2 原始 PDF，题干只把 PDF 排版规范为 LaTeX，没有改写或编造题目。 ::: ## 1. Core knowledge ::: {.formula-panel} ### Reverse differentiation $$ \begin{aligned} \int e^{ax+b}\,dx&=\frac1a e^{ax+b}+C,\\ \int\frac{1}{ax+b}\,dx&=\frac1a\ln|ax+b|+C,\\ \int\sin(ax+b)\,dx&=-\frac1a\cos(ax+b)+C,\\ \int\cos(ax+b)\,dx&=\frac1a\sin(ax+b)+C,\\ \int\sec^2(ax+b)\,dx&=\frac1a\tan(ax+b)+C. \end{aligned} $$ Paper 2 不要求 general substitution method；这里的重点是认出 reverse chain rule，并把 coefficient $a$ 除掉。 ::: ::: {.worked-example} Worked example · Integration note p.13 ![Integration trigonometric identities](../assets/notes/integration/worked-example-01.webp){.note-figure fig-alt="Original extracted integration note worked example using trigonometric identities before integration"} ::: ::: {.formula-panel} ### Trigonometric relationships before integrating 常用恒等式包括 $$ \sin^2x=\frac{1-\cos2x}{2}, \qquad \cos^2x=\frac{1+\cos2x}{2}, $$ 以及 $$ \sin2x=2\sin x\cos x, \qquad \sin x\cot\frac{x}{2}=1+\cos x. $$ 先把 integrand 化成 standard integral，再积分；不要在还没有化简时直接套公式。 ::: ::: {.worked-example} Worked example · Integration note p.19 ![Substitution example](../assets/notes/integration/worked-example-03.webp){.note-figure fig-alt="Original extracted integration note worked example with a composite trigonometric integral"} ::: ::: {.formula-panel} ### Definite integration 若 $F'(x)=f(x)$，则 $$ \int_a^b f(x)\,dx=F(b)-F(a). $$ 每一步都保留上下限；若出现 logarithm，要使用 $$ \ln u-\ln v=\ln\left(\frac uv\right). $$ ::: ::: {.worked-example} Worked example · Integration note p.22 ![Substitution and initial condition](../assets/notes/integration/worked-example-04.webp){.note-figure fig-alt="Original extracted integration note worked example using a definite integral and an initial condition"} ::: ::: {.formula-panel} ### Trapezium rule 把区间 $[a,b]$ 分成 $n$ 个等宽小区间，$h=(b-a)/n$，则 $$ \int_a^b f(x)\,dx \approx\frac h2\left[y_0+y_n+2(y_1+y_2+\cdots+y_{n-1})\right]. $$ 若 $f$ 在区间内 concave down，chords 位于 curve 下方，trapezium rule 给出 under-estimate；若 concave up，则给出 over-estimate。 ::: ## 2. Verified Paper 2 past-paper questions 以下 5 组题均已在本地 Paper 2 原始 PDF 及对应 mark scheme 中核对；题目没有因为数量不足而补造。 ::: {.question-card #p2-int-q01} ### Question 1 · 9709/21/M/J/20 Q7(a–b) (a) Find the quotient when $$ 9x^3-6x^2-20x+1 $$ is divided by $(3x+2)$, and show that the remainder is $9$. (b) Hence find $$ \int_1^6\frac{9x^3-6x^2-20x+1}{3x+2}\,dx, $$ giving the answer in the form $a+\ln b$ where $a$ and $b$ are integers. **[3+5]**
Show detailed mark scheme answer (a) Polynomial division gives $$ 9x^3-6x^2-20x+1=(3x+2)(3x^2-4x-4)+9. $$ Therefore $$ \boxed{\text{quotient}=3x^2-4x-4,\qquad \text{remainder}=9}. $$ (b) Use the division result: $$ \frac{9x^3-6x^2-20x+1}{3x+2}=3x^2-4x-4+\frac9{3x+2}. $$ Hence $$ \begin{aligned} \int_1^6\frac{9x^3-6x^2-20x+1}{3x+2}\,dx &=\left[x^3-2x^2-4x+3\ln(3x+2)\right]_1^6\\ &=(120+3\ln20)-(-5+3\ln5)\\ &=125+3\ln4\\ &=\boxed{125+\ln64}. \end{aligned} $$
Source: `PastPaper/2020/2020/9709-s20-qp-21.pdf`, Q7(a–b), and matching mark scheme.
::: ::: {.question-card #p2-int-q02} ### Question 2 · 9709/22/M/J/20 Q8(c) Find the exact value of $$ \int_{\frac14\pi}^{\frac12\pi}3\sin x\cot\frac12x\,dx. $$ **[5]**
Show detailed mark scheme answer Use $\sin x=2\sin(x/2)\cos(x/2)$: $$ \sin x\cot\frac x2 =2\sin\frac x2\cos\frac x2\cdot\frac{\cos(x/2)}{\sin(x/2)} =2\cos^2\frac x2 =1+\cos x. $$ Therefore the integral is $$ \begin{aligned} \int_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}3(1+\cos x)\,dx &=\left[3x+3\sin x\right]_{\pi/4}^{\pi/2}\\ &=3\left(\frac\pi2+1-\frac\pi4-\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\right). \end{aligned} $$ Hence $$ \boxed{\frac34\pi+3-\frac32\sqrt2}. $$
Source: `PastPaper/2020/2020/9709-s20-qp-22.pdf`, Q8(c), and matching mark scheme.
::: ::: {.question-card #p2-int-q03} ### Question 3 · 9709/22/M/J/22 Q4(a–b) (a) Use the trapezium rule with three intervals to show that the value of $$ \int_1^4\ln x\,dx $$ is approximately $\ln12$. (b) Use a graph of $y=\ln x$ to show that $\ln12$ is an under-estimate of the true value of the integral. **[4+2]**
Show detailed mark scheme answer (a) With three intervals on $[1,4]$, $h=1$ and the values are $$ y_0=\ln1,quad y_1=\ln2,quad y_2=\ln3,quad y_3=\ln4. $$ The trapezium rule gives $$ \begin{aligned} T_3 &=\frac12\left[\ln1+2\ln2+2\ln3+\ln4\right]\\ &=\frac12\left[0+2\ln2+2\ln3+2\ln2\right]\\ &=\ln2+\ln3+\ln2\\ &=\boxed{\ln12}. \end{aligned} $$ (b) The graph $y=\ln x$ is concave down on $x>0$. Therefore each straight chord used by the trapezium rule lies below the curve, so the trapezium areas are smaller than the true area. Hence $\ln12$ is $$ \boxed{\text{an under-estimate}}. $$
Source: `PastPaper/2022/2022/9709_s22_qp_22.pdf`, Q4(a–b), and matching mark scheme.
::: ## 3. 2024 Paper 2 additions 以下题目来自新增的 2024 Paper 2 原始 PDF，并已与对应 mark scheme 核对。 ::: {.question-card #p2-int-q04} ### Question 4 · 9709/22/M/J/24 Q5(b) The polynomial $p(x)$ is defined by $$ p(x)=9x^3+18x^2+5x+4. $$ Find the value of $$ \int_0^2\frac{p(x)}{3x+2}\,dx, $$ giving your answer in the form $a+\ln b$ where $a$ and $b$ are integers. **[5]**
Show detailed mark scheme answer From polynomial division, $$ p(x)=(3x+2)(3x^2+4x-1)+6. $$ Thus $$ \frac{p(x)}{3x+2}=3x^2+4x-1+\frac6{3x+2}. $$ Therefore $$ \begin{aligned} \int_0^2\frac{p(x)}{3x+2}\,dx &=\left[x^3+2x^2-x+2\ln(3x+2)\right]_0^2\\ &=(8+8-2+2\ln8)-2\ln2\\ &=14+2\ln4\\ &=\boxed{14+\ln16}. \end{aligned} $$
Source: `PastPaper/2024/2024/qp-202406-mathematics-p22.pdf`, Q5(b), and matching mark scheme.
::: ::: {.question-card #p2-int-q05} ### Question 5 · 9709/21/M/J/24 Q7(a–b) The polynomial $p(x)$ is defined by $$ p(x)=9x^3+6x^2+12x+k, $$ where $k$ is a constant. (a) Find the quotient when $p(x)$ is divided by $(3x+2)$ and show that the remainder is $(k-8)$. (b) It is given that $$ \int_1^6\frac{p(x)}{3x+2}\,dx=a+\ln64, $$ where $a$ is an integer. Find the values of $a$ and $k$. **[3+6]**
Show detailed mark scheme answer (a) Polynomial division gives $$ 9x^3+6x^2+12x+k=(3x+2)(3x^2+4)+(k-8). $$ Hence $$ \boxed{\text{quotient}=3x^2+4,\qquad \text{remainder}=k-8}. $$ (b) Using the result from (a), $$ \frac{p(x)}{3x+2}=3x^2+4+\frac{k-8}{3x+2}. $$ Integrate and apply the limits: $$ \begin{aligned} \int_1^6\frac{p(x)}{3x+2}\,dx &=\left[x^3+4x+\frac{k-8}{3}\ln(3x+2)\right]_1^6\\ &=235+\frac{k-8}{3}\ln4. \end{aligned} $$ Since $\ln64=3\ln4$, comparison gives $$ \frac{k-8}{3}=3 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \boxed{k=17}. $$ The integer part is therefore $$ \boxed{a=235}. $$
Source: `PastPaper/2024/2024/qp-202406-mathematics-p21.pdf`, Q7(a–b), and matching mark scheme.
:::
